χ.name: Chi
χ.meaning: Greek chi: often a second wavefunction or orbital (alongside φ and ψ), or a susceptibility.

Ω.name: Capital Omega
Ω.meaning: Greek capital omega: a solid angle, the Berry curvature of a band in momentum space, or a cosmological density parameter.

BZ.name: Brillouin zone
BZ.meaning: The repeating cell of crystal momentum space: momenta differing by a reciprocal lattice vector describe the same state, so momentum integrals run over this cell only.

τ.name: Tau
τ.meaning: Greek tau: a proper time measured by a moving clock, a lifetime, or a characteristic time constant.

∂.name: Partial derivative ∂_μ
∂.meaning: Written with an index, ∂_μ means the partial derivative with respect to the coordinate x^μ (time and the three space directions).

eq.name: Equilibrium (subscript)
eq.meaning: Subscript 'eq': the value a quantity would have in thermal equilibrium, e.g. n_eq is the equilibrium number density.

μν.name: Index pair μν
μν.meaning: Two spacetime indices, each running over 0-3. Down (_μν) or up (^μν); a repeated pair, one up and one down, is summed over.

ε.name: Epsilon
ε.meaning: Greek epsilon: a small quantity such as a tiny step or interval, an efficiency, or an energy level.
